positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Malware Research Team
  - Develop and implement heuristic rules and signatures to identify and assess malware risks.
  - Conduct reverse engineering and in-depth static and dynamic analysis of malware samples to uncover functionalities, vulnerabilities, and mitigation strategies.
  - Research and evaluate advanced AI and machine learning models aimed at improving malware detection accuracy and automating threat identification processes
positions.insights: Skills: Rust (Programming Language) · Python · Scala · Reverse Engineering · x86 Assembly · Machine Learning

positions.title: Lecturer
positions.description:
Design and teach undergraduate courses in systems programming, embedded systems, assembly language, and control systems.

Courses taught:
- EE3233 – Systems Programming for Engineers
- EE4953 – Introduction to x86-64 Assembly
- EE3413 – Analysis and Design of Control Systems
- CPE4953 – Embedded Systems Programming
positions.insights: Skills: Higher Education Teaching · C · Python

company.name: The University of Texas at San Antonio

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
(Phylum was acquired by Veracode in Jan 2025)

Core Platform Team Lead
  - Expanded platform ecosystem support to include PyPI, Maven, Cargo, and Go, significantly broadening package ingestion capabilities.
  - Developed ingestion features for ecosystem-specific lockfiles and manifests, enabling streamlined dependency analysis.
  - Designed and implemented monitoring systems to track and analyze real-time package updates and new releases.

Research Team
  - Created heuristic rules and signatures for proactive malware and spam detection.
  - Conducted detailed reverse engineering and analysis of malware samples to identify behaviors, vulnerabilities, and threat vectors.
  - Evaluated and developed advanced AI and machine learning models for enhanced malware and spam detection accuracy.
positions.insights: Skills: Rust (Programming Language) · Python · Scala · Reverse Engineering · Machine Learning

positions.title: Senior Cyber Developer
positions.description:
- Developed remote access tools tailored for embedded systems, enhancing system accessibility and control.
- Conducted reverse engineering of firmware utilizing the Ghidra software suite, enabling a deeper understanding of system operations.
- Engineered abstraction layers to standardize system calls, ensuring compatibility and modularity across different platforms.
- Established hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) pipeline to facilitate continuous integration and testing in real-time operational environments.
- Authored a suite of binary configuration and patching tools using Python, streamlining system updates and maintenance procedures.

positions.title: Computer Scientist
positions.description:
90th Cyberspace Operations Squadron - Senior Developer and Android Tech lead
- Engineered native Android applications tailored for offensive cyber operations.
- Constructed cross-compilation Docker containers to streamline build processes and enhance pipeline efficiency.
- Developed user-mode libraries for Windows utilizing both Win32 and Native API frameworks.
- Collaborated in the design and implementation of comprehensive training programs to cultivate the skills of apprentice and journeyman developers.

positions.title: EW Engineer
positions.description:
Conducted thorough analysis and research on various defense systems, including radar, missiles, anti-aircraft artillery (AAA), and communications, to ensure the continuous updating and accuracy of the Combat Support Database (CSDB) for the U.S. Air Force 453rd Electronic Warfare Squadron.

Developed and sustained analyst tools, as well as engineered software solutions for data mining and automated report generation.
